code_first.code:
requiredMB = 1200
availableMB = 800
if requiredMB > availableMB then
    print("Storage backing needed")
endif
p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Explain which OS technique could be involved when RAM is insufficient.
code_first.a: Prints backing needed; then no output; virtual memory/page backing.

original_exam_questions: What does MDR hold during a memory operation? [2 marks]
Give one difference between RAM and ROM. [2 marks]
RAM is volatile working memory; ROM is non-volatile and commonly stores firmware.
Explain one disadvantage of an HDD in a moving laptop. [3 marks]
Moving mechanical parts make it more vulnerable to physical shock.

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: If required RAM exceeds free RAM, secondary backing might be used.

mastery.task: Design a memory monitor which processes changing available RAM and warns if a request would require virtual memory, without claiming it always allocates successfully.
mastery.hint: Distinguish shortage from OS allocation policy.
mastery.answer: For requests 800,1200 with freeRAM800: first fits, second shortage400; equal boundary fits; virtual-memory warning is an estimate.
